title: Standards-based engineering semantic round-trip fixture blueprints

standards.version: current-release label on official standard download page; February 2025
published 2026-02-27; exact XMI asset digest not yet frozen
model documentation site serves Version 2.8; release and XMI digest require pinning
public schema index lists XSD files modified 2026-02-22

cases.title: Semantic PMI part round-trip
cases.intent: Preserve a bounded part definition, units, datums, and machine-interpretable PMI through a pinned AP242 exchange path.
required_semantics: distinction between semantic and presentation PMI

cases.title: Assembly structure and instance-transform round-trip
cases.intent: Preserve product structure, exact component variants, external identifiers, and assembly instance transforms.

cases.title: Design-characteristic to QIF inspection lineage
cases.intent: Bind an inspection plan and result to exact design characteristics and an exact article/configuration generation.

cases.title: Manufacturing-event context linkage
cases.intent: Link manufacturing-device observations to the correct device, job, lot, article, and inspection context without treating telemetry as conformity proof.

cases.title: Semantic PMI downgraded to presentation-only annotation
cases.intent: Detect an exchange path that preserves a visually plausible annotation while dropping machine-interpretable PMI semantics.
cases.seeded_fault: Replace or drop semantic PMI while retaining a rendered graphical annotation.

cases.title: Datum, unit, or coordinate-frame corruption
cases.intent: Detect silent changes in dimensional units, datum references, axis orientation, handedness, or coordinate origin.
cases.seeded_fault: Apply one controlled unit-scale or frame/datum mutation while leaving geometry appearance superficially plausible.

cases.title: QIF result rebound to the wrong design generation
cases.intent: Detect an inspection record attached to a same-named characteristic or article from a different design/configuration generation.
cases.seeded_fault: Keep the friendly name but replace the exact generation or characteristic reference.

cases.title: Inspection result loses calibration or uncertainty context
cases.intent: Detect a measurement result whose instrument calibration, measurement equation, or uncertainty/dependence context is missing or inapplicable.
cases.seeded_fault: Remove or stale the calibration/uncertainty reference while retaining a numeric result.

cases.title: MTConnect timebase or device identity substitution
cases.intent: Detect clock-domain drift, event reordering, stale observations, or a device/adapter identity rebound.
cases.seeded_fault: Shift a timestamp or substitute an asset identity without changing the payload's human-readable label.

cases.title: Unsupported semantics or provenance loss silently accepted
cases.intent: Detect partial imports, unsupported extensions, content-digest mismatches, or broken provenance links that are incorrectly reported as complete.
cases.seeded_fault: Drop an unsupported extension or alter a referenced artifact digest while returning a nominally successful import.

limitations: All ten records are public authoring blueprints, not adjudicated gold cases.
No candidate output, expected answer key, hidden oracle, execution trace, or benchmark score is included.
The standard baselines are pinned for this research profile; the fixture corpus does not claim full standards coverage or certification.
Candidate execution, untrusted execution, and physical testing remain unauthorized.
Any later scoring requires independent adjudication, frozen toolchains, and separate evaluator custody.

MTConnect public version labels are not yet reconciled across the standard-download page, normative SysML model releases, model documentation, and generated XML schemas. No MTConnect adapter is eligible for scoring until exact XMI, XSD, agent and protocol revisions are separately pinned and compatibility is independently reviewed.

required_frozen_tuple: official normative model/XMI release identity and SHA-256
exact XSD bundle files and SHA-256 digests
schema validator implementation and exact version
independent compatibility witness linking the selected model, XSD, agent and protocol
mtconnect_execution_gate.phase_policy: The first executable exchange tranche is AP242 Edition 4 ↔ QIF ISO 23952:2020 only. MTConnect event cases remain blueprint-only and may not be executed or scored until the complete compatibility tuple is frozen and independently reviewed.
mtconnect_execution_gate.rejection_rule: Any unresolved version mismatch, absent digest, unsupported schema/profile or missing compatibility witness is Unsupported/Unknown, never Pass.
